title: What Lava Tube Habitats Is

title: Readiness Estimator: Lava Tube Habitats
definition: Estimates Lava Tube Habitats readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Lava Tube Habitats components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a habitat hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Lava Tube Habitats Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Lava Tube Habitats operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Lava Tube Habitats installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 27910 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where tube surveys monitoring, habitat logistics redundancy, or sealing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Lava Tube Habitats Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Lava Tube Habitats: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Lava Tube Habitats — habitats inside lunar and Martian lava tubes.

Phase 1 — Prove (tube surveys): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (habitat logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sealing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (radiation shelter): habitat hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and Moon-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
